verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a hosted service, but nothing in the evidence shows Porkbun's core registrar, DNS or hosting service can be self-hosted; it is offered only as a hosted service reached through its API. The locally runnable MCP server (npx @porkbunllc/mcp-server) only connects clients to the hosted account, and the Cloudflare DNS handoff moves records to another hosted provider, so neither counts as self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
